about_the_game:
Madam Marigold’s revival plan didn’t quite work. Her resurrection potion was a dud and now your Aunt's body is buried in the backyard of her famous Potion Emporium & Goat Rental. As her sole heir, you’re now the proud owner of that creaky potion shop, its missing goat and one sassy owl who claims to be part of the staff.

You didn’t ask for this. You didn’t study alchemy. Perhaps you don’t even like frogs. But don’t let that stop you!

In this cozy-but-chaotic fantasy sim, you'll forage, brew, and hustle your way from clueless newcomer to fully-fledged potion master by gathering ingredients in the wild (watch out for sarcastic mushrooms), experimenting with bubbling cauldrons, and discovering new recipes that range from mildly helpful to accidentally sentient. Then open shop, price your potions, and try to survive the daily rush of demanding locals, amorous orcs, and picky dwarves. And if you can make it through all of that, maybe you’ll even manage to brew a resurrection potion that actually works someday.

Features:

  • A World That Revolves Around You: Every potion you sell influences what happens in The Mostly-United Queendom of Bumblescratch. You might even start a few wars! But don’t worry - who hasn’t? 

  • Curious Customers: From wannabe-barista-blacksmiths to goblin influencers, your customers have opinions. Lots of them.

  • Make Magic: Not every potion you brew will be perfect, but you won’t know until someone else tries it! Your customers will use your creations right in front of you so that you can see whether it hits the spot or gives them spots. 

  • Forage, Brew, Sell, Repeat: Explore the valley, gather ingredients, master potion recipes, and keep your shelves stocked for every kind of adventurer. 

  • Explore with friends: Sign up friends and family to help in your shop, forage together and marvel at the wonders of potions gone wrong in co-op multiplayer!

Come for the cosy crafting, stay for the colourful cast of customers. Welcome to the weirdest little potion shop in the realm -  we saved you a ladle!

name: Potions, Please!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Amd Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 1050 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X / Intel i7-9700K or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 2070 / Radeon RX 5700XT or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 MB available space

short_description: A cozy-but-chaotic fantasy potion shop sim where you’ve inherited the business from your late aunty whose resurrection potion didn’t quite work. Forage, brew, sell to eccentric customers, and maybe, just maybe, figure out how to bring her back.
